run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T10:58:07Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend is explained by the otel-demo/product-catalog Deployment: its pod template was rolled at 10:56 with container command ["invalid-command"], which the product-catalog image does not contain. The new ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf (created 2026-11-17T10:56:16Z, container command ["invalid-command"]) replaced product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (created 10:26:15Z, container command null) on the identical image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog, so this was a configuration-only change. The resulting pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l is Ready=False with restartCount 5, CrashLoopBackOff, and last termination StartError exit code 128 with message 'exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH'. The pod never becomes ready, the product-catalog Service has only notReadyAddresses, and product-catalog's own span rate falls to 0. From the 10:58:00Z rate point, frontend error-status spans appear only on operations that call product-catalog (grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, GET /api/products/{productId}) and on the operations that depend on them (recommendation ListProducts/get_product_list, checkout GetProduct/PlaceOrder), while the frontend, frontend-proxy, checkout and recommendation pods stay Running/Ready with 0 restarts.

claims.text: In the hour ending 11:07:39Z frontend carried error-status spans on GET (increase 3118.75), grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (2451.2), GET /api/products/{productId} (2451.2), grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations (468.27), GET /api/recommendations (468.27), grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (312.79), POST /api/checkout (312.69) and tcp.connect (17.32); these are span counts, not request counts.

Frontend error-rate deviation begins at the 10:58:00Z rate point: frontend GET was 0 at every sampled point from 10:45:00Z through 10:57:00Z, then 1.2/s at 10:58:00Z, 3.74/s at 11:00:00Z and 4.95/s at 11:05:00Z; GET /api/products/{productId} and grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct follow the same onset and level, reaching 4.15/s at 11:05:00Z.

Pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l in otel-demo is Running but its product-catalog container is not ready, restartCount 5, state CrashLoopBackOff with 'back-off 2m40s restarting failed container', and lastState terminated with exitCode 128, reason StartError, message 'failed to create containerd task ... runc create failed: unable to start container process: error during container init: exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH'.

Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog (deployment.kubernetes.io/revision 2, metadata.generation 4) sets spec.template.spec.containers[0].command = ["invalid-command"] for container product-catalog with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog, while every other otel-demo Deployment (accounting, ad, cart, checkout, currency, email, flagd, fraud-detection, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, kafka, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, postgresql, quote, recommendation, shipping, valkey-cart) has command null.

The superseded ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (created 2026-11-17T10:26:15Z) had container command null, while the new ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf (created 2026-11-17T10:56:16Z) has container command ["invalid-command"]; both use the identical image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog.

Events record the rollout at 10:56: Deployment product-catalog ScalingReplicaSet scaled product-catalog-fcf7564cf 0->1 and product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc 1->0; pod product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-wzpwm was killed at 10:56:25Z; pods product-catalog-fcf7564cf-2fvnx and -vjj7l emitted Warning Failed events with message 'exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH' (counts 2 and 6) and Warning BackOff events (counts 1 and 25).

The product-catalog Service (clusterIP 100.64.32.100, port 8080, selector opentelemetry.io/name=product-catalog) resolves to a single Endpoints object whose only entry is notReadyAddresses for pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l (ip 100.96.2.148); there is no ready address.

Product-catalog's own span rate, steady at about 10.4-10.9/s from 10:40:00Z through 10:57:00Z, declines after the 10:58:00Z point (8.54, 5.86, 3.21, 0.34 per 5m-rate points) and is 0 from the 11:02:00Z point onward.

Recommendation error spans on /oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts and get_product_list and checkout error spans on oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder are 0 at the 10:57:00Z point and become non-zero in the 10:59:00Z bucket (0.217/s and 0.132/s), reaching 0.966/s and 0.612/s at 11:06:00Z; frontend-proxy ingress and router frontend egress error rates, about 0.0037/s baseline, jump in the 10:58:00Z bucket to 1.34/s each and reach 6.37/s and 6.35/s at 11:06:00Z.

Error-span totals over the 20m ending 11:07:39Z by service: frontend 13203.85, frontend-proxy 7020.22, recommendation 945.00, checkout 584.53, ad 2.06, and 0 for accounting, fraud-detection and payment.

Product-catalog's own server spans in the hour carried only status_code STATUS_CODE_UNSET for oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (12850.98) and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts (1101.40); no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series exists for service_name product-catalog.
The caller-side pods are Running and Ready with 0 restarts: frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5, frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-qd6ch, checkout-5dccddf8bb-8fzjm, recommendation-5f45f75855-xrpch.

Ad's only error signal, flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream, stayed at background level around 0.0037/s at the 10:55:00Z, 11:00:00Z and 11:05:00Z points, with ResolveBoolean at 0 throughout; it did not step up after the 10:58 onset.

The alerting service's own workload was not changed or restarted: Deployment frontend is revision 1 generation 1 with container command null, and pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 is Ready with restartCount 0, so frontend's errors are on its outbound calls rather than caused by a frontend template change or pod failure.

Frontend error spans are not spread across all its dependencies: grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, GET /api/cart and GET /api/data all show 0 errors at every sampled point from 10:45:00Z through 11:07:00Z, while the product-catalog-dependent operations rise from 10:58:00Z.

An application-level product-catalog fault flag was considered and rejected as this cause: the flagd-config ConfigMap declares productCatalogFailure with defaultVariant 'off', and the observed failure is a container start failure (exec "invalid-command" not found, exitCode 128 StartError) on a pod that never serves, while product-catalog's own server spans carry only STATUS_CODE_UNSET rather than application error statuses; the runtime flagd value could not be read.

A frontend-side regression (bad deploy or restart of the alerting service) was considered and rejected: the frontend Deployment is generation 1 revision 1, its pod is Ready with 0 restarts, and its error onset coincides with product-catalog's pod becoming unready at 10:56 and with product-catalog's own span rate reaching 0.

Restore the product-catalog pod template to the image default by removing the command override ["invalid-command"] from Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog (the prior ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc had command null), then confirm the pod becomes Ready, the product-catalog Endpoints object gains a ready address, and frontend product-catalog error spans and the RequestErrorRate alert clear.

Add an admission or CI guard that rejects container command/args overrides for otel-demo workloads unless the entrypoint is known-valid, so a template change such as command ["invalid-command"] fails before it rolls out.

gaps: Who or what applied command ["invalid-command"] to Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog is unknown: change_history is not integrated and no Kubernetes audit trail is available; only the resulting Deployment (revision 2, generation 4), the two ReplicaSets and the 10:56 rollout events were observable.

Jaeger returned no traces for the frontend service in the 10:56:00Z-11:07:39Z window: traces_search (view 3a338ea8-28df-45a2-ad4f-5976079a3077) and traces_search_by_tags with error=true (view f82419c1-b22b-4e1c-9cbe-d294e85facc9) and by operation grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (view 1d6d2da9-689d-4bb4-bd61-cfb62dd86c89) each returned nothing, so individual failing span messages could not be read and caller error evidence is span-metric based.

Application logs could not be used: fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 returned no lines (views c724858e-b321-4767-a022-3ce3d18d2f4b and b14ace54-55bb-4145-9057-d2556c390b12) and for product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l returned no lines with no previous container instance (view 1225338f-7bbf-4432-bc95-dd6d782fa0ce), consistent with a container that never starts but not proof of anything the containers wrote.

The alert's rule expression could not be verified: list_prometheus_rules returned no rule named RequestErrorRate (view e78eb636-145f-4be6-9f74-cdb1c418c461) and no alerting rules at all (view b2cd1fd4-1cf0-4557-a44d-c4e6a60d8bf2), so the alert payload value 16.8667 was not recomputed from a rule.

No http_server_request_duration_seconds_count series exists (view 23e0e713-870c-4162-a5d4-8487f66e80f2), rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count returned nothing (view 1e9a5b1a-773c-4e56-8118-f193f94e6d31), and the kube_deployment_status_* series returned nothing (view d31f67a0-bd8f-4a7a-8565-f4fb7e661baa), so there is no HTTP status-code breakdown and no deployment ready/available time series; readiness evidence comes from pod status, Endpoints and events.

A NetworkPolicy query for otel-demo (view 85ea58c1-c7c3-48fd-854a-e7e9ad749373) and a ResourceQuota query for otel-demo (view ce785fae-cf7b-4359-ba6d-a32f81e1b675) each returned no items, which shows only that those queries matched nothing.

A get_metric_names query for http/rpc/app_/kube_deployment patterns returned nothing (view 57576686-ffa3-40d4-a112-2f32e64f2943); the only product-catalog series present are traces_span_metrics_calls_total and traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket (view 66ce91f8-ce31-4821-81e0-ddcbb72f06cf), so pod-level CPU/memory cause analysis was not possible for this workload.

Pod fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-8bpr4 restarted in the window (Created/Started events count 2 at 10:46:19Z and container restartCount 1) before the 10:58 onset, and its own error-span increase is 0; the reason for that restart was not determined and it is not placed as impact of this cause.

Events in namespace data-recorders (Job Completed/SuccessfulCreate, PVC provisioning, Deployment/ReplicaSet scaling per view fa259232-5cae-4b3c-9e42-611398216e8d) were observed only as grouped counts and were not investigated; no relation to the frontend error rate was established.
next_steps: Revert Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog to the prior template (container command null) and watch pod readiness, the product-catalog Endpoints ready address, and frontend product-catalog error spans.

Pull Kubernetes audit logs or Helm/GitOps revision history for Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog around 2026-11-17T10:56Z to identify who applied command ["invalid-command"]; change_history was not integrated in this Run.

After recovery, confirm with a side-by-side window that frontend error rate on grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and GET /api/products/{productId} returns to its pre-10:58 baseline of zero.
